## MidnightRepayWithdrawCollateralAction interface

Metadata for a Midnight bundle that repays credit and/or withdraws collateral.

export interface MidnightRepayWithdrawCollateralAction extends BaseAction<"midnightRepayWithdrawCollateral", {
